description.it: Infortuni e squalifiche dei giocatori del club scelto.
description.en: Injuries and suspensions of the chosen club's players.

widgets.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM injuries WHERE club_uid = :club AND kind = 'history'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM suspensions WHERE club_uid = :club

title.it: Tipi di infortunio più frequenti (dove il gioco li registra)
title.en: Most frequent injury types (where the game records them)

widgets.sql: SELECT type_name, count(*) AS injuries FROM injuries WHERE club_uid = :club AND type_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type_name ORDER BY injuries DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT player_name, count(*) AS injuries FROM injuries WHERE club_uid = :club AND kind = 'history' GROUP BY player_uid ORDER BY injuries DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT date, player_name, type_name, severity, cause FROM injuries WHERE club_uid = :club AND kind = 'history' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT issued_date, player_name, scope FROM suspensions WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY issued_date DESC
